protocol.prototype: client-local conditional mean gradients, weighted by n_kb/N_b
protocol.correction: strength * sum_b (pi_b - h_kb) c_b; added before optimizer.step
protocol.optimizer_state: persistent per client, stored on CPU between visits

learning_rate_schedule.name: cosine
learning_rate_schedule.application: global communication round; fixed within round; no warm-up or restarts; identical across methods/conditions
learning_rate_schedule.state_restore: set lr after restoring each client optimizer state
learning_rate_schedule.recorded_lr: rounds.csv learning_rate is the rate used in the just-completed round; blank at round 0

protocol.diagnostics: full training gradients at one common current global model
protocol.communication: logical uncompressed tensor bytes, not measured network traffic
protocol.privacy: offline benchmark bins; no DP or secure aggregation guarantee
protocol.resume: completed method/condition/seed runs only; not mid-round checkpoint recovery
protocol.units: test_error is relative L2; paired error differences are percentage points
protocol.scope: SGD identity at a shared model; Adam/momentum variants are empirical

participation.sampling: uniform without replacement within each round; independent across rounds
participation.pairing: same schedule for IID and all alphas at a given seed
participation.aggregation: selected-client sample weights n_k / sum_{j in S_t} n_j
participation.optimizer_state: inactive clients retain their optimizer state unchanged
participation.local_update_variance: weighted variance among selected clients in the preceding round
participation.diagnostic_scope: all clients at checkpoints; diagnostic gradients do not update model
